newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks jump in early morning after US rally.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks jump in early morning after US rally.

text.p: Tokyo stocks jumped in early Friday morning trade following the U.S. Dow Industrials' climb to a new record high overnight, brokers said.
But they said the Tokyo market could be trapped in a limited range later in the day.
At 0020 GMT, the key 225-share Nikkei average was up 81.05 points or 0.38 percent at 21,504.79. Its December futures had gained 80 points to 21,580.
"Stock prices are likely to continue hovering ahead of the elections the day after tomorrow," said an anlyst at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
